events.title: Fraser Health AI Agents at Work
events.description:
As health systems explore increasingly capable AI agents, the challenge is not simply where AI can be applied, but how to deploy it in ways that are clinically relevant, operationally valuable and sustainable. This presentation showcases Fraser Health’s experience building a broad AI portfolio across clinical, operational and corporate settings, with multiple solutions in active production and several sustained beyond the pilot stage over several years.

Fraser Health’s AI journey spans a progression from Generate, Automate, Inform and Navigate to Prioritize and Optimize, reflecting increasing levels of capability, agency and complexity. Examples include workforce automation, clinical workflow support, digital care navigation, quality and patient safety applications, medical imaging triage, and predictive discharge planning.

The presentation also highlights the organizational conditions that enable sustained adoption, including workflow selection, readiness, intake and prioritization, and governance. Together, these examples illustrate how Fraser Health is moving AI beyond proof of concept into sustained operational use while maintaining alignment with clinical priorities and measurable value for patients, providers and operations.

events.title: Dreaming of a ‘Star Trek’ Clinic: Boldly Listening to Physicians on What EMRs Should Do
events.description: As Canada advances toward more integrated and AI-enabled health systems, physicians continue to experience electronic medical record (EMR) frustrations that impact patient care and workflow efficiency. This mixed method study explores what physicians truly need from their EMRs versus what they find unacceptable, through a provincial study and specialty-specific focus groups. By identifying priority functionalities and key design gaps, this work offers evidence-based insights to inform EMR redesign, interoperability initiatives, and physician-centred digital health strategies.

events.title: Documentation Workflow Gaps in Hospital-Based Electronic Record Systems and Their Association with Patient Safety Risks
events.description: This presentation explores how gaps in clinical documentation workflows within hospital-based electronic record systems can contribute to patient safety risks. Drawing on a systematic review of the literature, it examines issues involving medication documentation, handoffs and transitions of care, structured EHR data quality, patient identification, and nursing documentation, while highlighting opportunities for workflow redesign and the role of Health Information Management professionals in supporting safer digital documentation practices.

events.title: MEDINFO27
events.description:
Dubai brings you MEDINFO 2027 the 21st World Congress on Medical and Health Informatics proudly presented by Emirates Health Informatics Society & Emirates Health Association on behalf of the International Medical Informatics Association (IMIA)

This marks the first time the Middle East will host this prestigious global biomedical and health informatics event, highlighting Dubai’s visionary leadership, digital readiness, world-class infrastructure, and commitment to healthcare sustainability. The event is organized by the Emirates Health Informatics Society, with support from the Department of Economy and Tourism (DET), Dubai Health Authority (DHA), UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention, Emirates Health Services, and other key stakeholders.

As the premier event for the global biomedical and health informatics community, the biennial MedInfo serves as a key platform for exchanging cutting-edge research and ideas. It provides invaluable opportunities for both formal discussions and informal networking among IMIA’s global members. This esteemed international gathering attracts thousands of leading digital health professionals, making it a landmark event on the global calendar. It highlights the collaboration between public and private sectors to advance accessible, safe, and secure health solutions.

Let’s connect international and national audience, to network, share, and highlight the latest achievements, advancements, research and innovation in digital health and health informatics in true Dubai style. Welcome to Dubai!
